lines: Devang Mehta can sell up to ₹2.25 crore if all offered shares are sold, with proceeds up to ₹2.25 crore.
The money has been in hand since 11 Mar 2026 (8 months ago); the shares unlocked on 9 Sep 2026.
Their retained stake is an estimate of ₹5.25 crore, valued at the offer price.
Average cost of acquisition is unknown, so the gain cannot be assessed; the name is verified but holdings appear in one section only.
